    Smallest sample size reaching a target power

    find_n.Rd

    Finds the smallest integer total sample size \(N\) with pwr_fun(N) >= power. The upper bound is found by doubling, then the solution by bisection, so pwr_fun must be non-decreasing in \(N\) (for sawtooth power functions see exact_n()).

    find_n(pwr_fun, power, n_low = 2, n_high = 1000, n_max = 1e+07)

    Arguments

    pwr_fun

    Function of a single sample size N returning the power (a number in \([0, 1]\)).

    power

    Target power.

    n_low

    Lower end of the search interval. A warning is given, and n_low returned, if the target is already reached there.

    n_high

    Initial upper end of the search interval, doubled until the target is reached.

    n_max

    Largest upper end tried before stopping with an error (target unreachable).

    Value

    The smallest integer \(N\) with pwr_fun(N) >= power.
